title: Reduction Operations to Make the Array Elements Equal
summary: Given an integer array nums, the task is to equalize all its elements through a series of operations.
statement: Given an integer array nums, the task is to equalize all its elements through a series of operations. Each operation involves identifying the largest element, then reducing it to the next largest value in the array. The process continues until all elements are identical, and the count of such operations is returned.
constraints: One operation changes one current maximum element to the next smaller distinct value present.
hints: After sorting, each higher value must cross every distinct lower level.
Scan upward while tracking how many distinct level boundaries have appeared.
Add that boundary count for each element.
Each added unit corresponds to one required reduction of that element across one level, giving a one-to-one count of all operations.
editorial: Each added unit corresponds to one required reduction of that element across one level, giving a one-to-one count of all operations.

tests.explanation: Five requires two reductions and three requires one, totaling three operations.
All values are already equal, so no operation is needed.
